name: sponcybot
description: SponcyBot - AI-Powered Sponsorship Outreach & CRM Platform

scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:full: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', {recursive: true});"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', {recursive: true});" || node -e "console.log('[Build] Using pre-compiled React bundle in backend/public');"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.test: cd backend && node src/scripts/testOutreachLogic.js && node src/scripts/testDeleteRejectedDraft.js && node src/scripts/testAuth.js
